feedback.answered: Two recorded boundaries are answered by reading. First, the installSnapshot watermark mismatch is specific to the log-clearing branch: installSnapshot either calls removeOldLogs for a MonotonicLogStore or compactLogs(req.LastLogIndex) otherwise, and compactLogsWithTrailing only deletes [FirstIndex, min(snapIdx, lastLogIdx-trailing)] where lastLogIdx is the watermark itself (snapshot.go 216-247), so in the non-monotonic branch the store never loses an entry above the watermark and the watermark still names a retained entry; the mismatch measured by check 58ebdb2f92184614b01ecfab56fe2bc9 requires removeOldLogs, which clears the store outright. Second, the follow-on of the confirmed snapshot-trigger underflow is redundant snapshot churn: runSnapshots calls takeSnapshot whenever shouldSnapshot returns true (snapshot.go 72-104), and in the state that triggers the underflow the FSM goroutine's lastIndex is the restored snapshot index, so takeSnapshot proceeds (snapshot.go 125-213) to create and persist a full FSM snapshot at that same index every interval, calling setLastSnapshot and compactLogs again - it repeats while the log store's last index stays below the snapshot index and stops once logs grow past it by SnapshotThreshold.
